name: San Francisco Virtual Warehouse
description: Free surplus furniture, supplies, and equipment from the City and County of San Francisco for nonprofits and schools
fullDescription: San Francisco's Virtual Warehouse, run by the SF Environment Department on the Rheaply platform, lets nonprofits and schools request free surplus items from City departments.
whatTheyOffer:
- Surplus City items such as office furniture, supplies, and equipment (availability varies)
- Online platform to view and request available items
- All items free of charge
howToGetIt:
1. Complete the Virtual Warehouse Non-Profit Sign Up Form (have your EIN, 501(c)(3) or other tax ID document, mission statement, and staff emails ready)
2. SF Environment verifies your organization is a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit in good standing (or school) and emails next steps within 2-3 weeks
3. Create your Rheaply account to view and request available items
4. Handle all pickup and transportation yourself
keywords: Virtual Warehouse, San Francisco, free furniture, nonprofit donation, office supplies, electronics, filing cabinets, public school, city surplus, SF Environment
